summary.text: Adam Beaty is the Republican candidate for Illinois House of Representatives District 80 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Anthony DeLuca (D).
Beaty is a patrol sergeant with the Braidwood Police Department and a small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Beaty was born in Hinsdale, Illinois, graduated from Neuqua Valley High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Lewis University in 2009.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has spent 12 years in law enforcement and owns The Memorial Guardian, a company that cleans and restores historical monuments and headstones.
Beaty won the March 17, 2026 Republican primary.

In the survey he listed lowering the cost of living, public safety and education among his priorities, and said he would fix parts of the SAFE-T Act and restore judges' discretion to detain dangerous repeat offenders.
